title: feat(types)!: retire `AIInsightsSchema` and the `ai-insights` node type (objectui#8800)
body:
Fixes #8800

Retires `AIInsightsSchema` and the `ai-insights` node type from the published
type face, under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove.

## The ruling this executes — quoted, not summarised

Director seat, decision batch #137 item 2, 2026-09-15, maintainer verbatim
「同意」, on objectui#8800. **Letter A** of the three the card offered:

> - **A** — `AIInsightsSchema` and the `ai-insights` node type are retired from the published type face under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: the declaration and its barrel export go; the objectui#8178 exclusion pin (`ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` :115 / :120 `Equal<…>`) is rewritten **by this ruling**, ⛔ not by refactor. `Clause-②: yes` (a published `.d.ts` member retires, objectui#8178 precedent).
> - **B** and **C** are refused.

and, on execution:

> Changeset `minor` on `@object-ui/types` with the **BREAKING** banner and the ADR-0087 disposition line (pre-GA retirement ships `minor`); the retirement follows the `spec-property-retirement` shape as objectui#8178 did.

⇒ **B** (write a renderer) and **C** (keep it as a documented forward
declaration) are closed. ⛔ Neither is re-proposed here.

⚠️ **The objectui#8178 exclusion pin is rewritten by that ruling, and by nothing
else.** That is an authorisation for one paragraph in one file. Every other line
of `ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` — the seven `?: never` member
tombstones objectui#8178 ruled on, their controls, their literals — is
byte-untouched, and the diff shows it.

## What changed — five files

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/ai.ts` | the `AIInsightsSchema` interface is gone; a tombstone comment stands where it was, carrying the ruling, the boundary against the three AI schemas that DO render, and the in-repo limit on the census |
| `packages/types/src/index.ts` | the barrel re-export is gone; the same shape objectui#4895's block-family retirement left behind — GONE, not emptied, with the reason at the site |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-zero-read-members-retired-8178.test.ts` | the exclusion paragraph, rewritten by ruling. Nothing else in the file moved |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts` | NEW — the successor pin |
| `.changeset/8800-retire-ai-insights.md` | `minor` on `@object-ui/types`, BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, FROM/TO and the one-line fix |

No renderer, no registration, no zod file and no document changed, because none
of them ever carried this spelling.

## Premises, re-derived on this branch — every zero with a control that fires

Taken on this branch's base `3ecc369bf`, ⛔ not inherited from the card.

| premise | verdict | reading, with its control |
|---|---|---|
| the spelling occurs exactly once under `packages/**` + `apps/**` | **HOLDS, and is tighter** — exactly once **tree-wide**, the `type` literal inside the declaration itself | `git grep -l` subject **1 file**; controls in the same run: `detail-view` **55**, `ai-recommendations` **8**; absent-token control, minted for this run, **0**. Population `git ls-files` **7833** |
| `AIInsightsSchema` is re-exported from the package barrel ⇒ on the PUBLISHED type surface | **HOLDS** | present in `dist/ai.d.ts` and in `dist/index.d.ts`'s re-export list on the base build, before the change |
| there is NO zod mirror for it | **HOLDS, and the instrument was made discriminating** | a bare grep of `src/zod/` scores **0** for the subject AND **0** for the sibling AI control, so that zero does not discriminate. The structural reading does: `src/zod/` mirrors a module as `NAME.zod.ts`, **18** modules are mirrored, and `ai` is not one of them — there is no `ai.zod.ts` at all. Control: `views` IS mirrored. Pinned as a standing leg in the new test |
| `AIInsightsSchema.objectName` was deliberately NOT retired by objectui#8178 | **HOLDS** — the pin asserted a type-level `Equal` holding that member at string-or-undefined, on the stated ground that the ruling named three schemas and the fourth "was neither screened nor decided". Both halves of that ground are discharged by objectui#8800, which screened it and decided it | the paragraph that replaces it says exactly this |

⭐ One reading the card did not have, measured here and worth the reviewer's
attention: the published zod validator `AnyComponentSchema` refuses
`ai-insights` — and refuses `ai-recommendations`, `ai-form-assist` and
`nl-query` too, all four `false`, against a `button` control that is `true`.
So the runtime half of this defect was never the zod face at all; the zod face
never accepted this node. `tsc` was the only thing that said yes. That is
pinned as a PREMISE leg, labelled as such, because it is green before and after
this change and is therefore ⛔ not evidence for it.

## The BREAKING banner, earned on the BUILT artifact

The banner is a claim about what consumers receive, so it was verified on
`dist/**.d.ts` after a clean rebuild (`tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` removed —
`check-dist-completeness` caught a partial dist first and named the repair,
which is the gate working), ⛔ not on the source.

```
AFTER · declaration of the symbol in dist/**.d.ts          0
AFTER · the `type: 'ai-insights'` member in dist/**.d.ts   0
AFTER · the symbol in dist/index.d.ts's re-export list     0
LIT CONTROL · sibling declaration still emitted            1
LIT CONTROL · sibling `type: 'ai-recommendations'` member  1
```

The external-consumer refusal, measured against the built face from outside the
repo tsconfig — one import of the retired symbol and one of a live sibling, same
module, same run:

```
error TS2305: Module '"./dist/index.js"' has no exported member 'AIInsightsSchema'.
```

exactly one error; the sibling import raised none. That is what an external
TypeScript consumer gets, and it is why the changeset spells out the FROM/TO.

⭐ The tombstone comment travels: `tsc` emits it into `dist/ai.d.ts`, so the
reasoning arrives in the consumer's own `node_modules` beside the absence.

## Reverse verification — the pin can fail, and it fails in the predicted direction

Predicted before running: RED. Run from the committed fix, mutation appended to
`ai.ts`, restored by an `EXIT INT TERM` trap that compares the blob hash back to
the `HEAD` blob and refuses an empty hash.

```
ON-DISK BEFORE: declaration anchor 0 · tombstone anchor 1
ON-DISK AFTER:  declaration anchor 1 · tombstone anchor 1     <- the mutation really landed
VITEST_EXIT=1   FAIL "the DECLARING module no longer declares the interface or the spelling"
TSC_EXIT=2      error TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive.   (the `../ai` leg)
RESTORED: blob 70bc05709c859c6c3a30f4cba58709d38ba8f756 == HEAD blob
```

⭐ Exactly **one** of the two `@ts-expect-error` legs went unused, not both — the
mutation re-added the declaration but not the barrel re-export, and the barrel
leg stayed used. The two directives discriminate two different faces rather
than duplicating one reading.

⚠️ **What the ablation shows the census does NOT cover, stated rather than
glossed:** the tree census excludes the two files this change edited (they carry
tombstone comments that name the symbol on purpose), so a re-add *in those two
files* is caught by the source-text and `tsc` legs, and the census is what
catches a re-add *anywhere else*. The exclusion list lives beside its reasons in
the test, ⛔ not in an allow-list file.

## Gates — hand-derived, because `dispatch-gates.mjs` cannot answer for this repo

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` lives in the sibling `objectstack` checkout and
refuses cross-repo by design, so there is no `--ran` reconciliation for this
branch and none is claimed. The roster below was derived by hand from this
repository's own `check:*` scripts and from `.github/workflows/` enumerated off
`origin/main` (⛔ not off the working tree). Exit codes captured by redirecting
first and reading `$?` after, ⛔ never across a pipe.

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` (clean, incl. `check-dist-completeness`) | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + examples + `tsconfig.test.json`) | 0 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` — 193 files, 4559 tests | 0 |
| `turbo run build` across the workspace — 43/43 tasks | 0 |
| `check-changeset-presence` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-fixed` · `check-changeset-claims` | 0 |
| `check-readme-exports` | 0 |
| `check-type-check-coverage` | 0 |
| `check-doc-component-types` · `check-doc-snippet-types` · `check-prompt-component-keys` | 0 |
| `check-component-surface-parity` · `check-designer-field-key-parity` · `check-spec-symbol-derivation` | 0 |
| `check-unreferenced-sources` · `check-package-self-import` · `check-phantom-dependencies` · `check-side-effects-array` | 0 |
| `check-node-esm-load` · `--specifiers-only` · `check-published-dist-tooling` · `check-dist-completeness --all` | 0 |
| `check-control-bytes` · `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` · `check-test-path-roots` · `check-vi-mock-override-shape` | 0 |
| `check-lint-coverage` (46/46) · `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` | 0 |
| `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on all five paths | 0 — **NOT GOVERNED** |
| `node packages/cli/dist/cli.js check` | 0 |

⚠️ `check-readme-exports` was red on the first attempt with a **PREREQUISITE NOT
MET**, not a finding: it refuses to measure when packages are unbuilt, and said
so in its own output. It is recorded green above only from the run after the
workspace build.

⚠️ eslint on `@object-ui/types` reports 0 errors and 288 pre-existing warnings.
The retirement *removed* one of them (the `data?: any[]` member went with the
interface); it added none.

⚠️ **Deliberate local narrowing, declared:** the repository-wide `pnpm test`
shards, `pnpm type-check` across every package, `pnpm lint` over the whole
workspace and `pnpm test:dist` are CI's runs and were not repeated here. The
workspace `turbo run build` above compiles every package with `tsc`, and the
tree census scores zero references to the retired symbol outside the two edited
files and the record — so no importer can break on a name nothing imports. CI
still runs the farm.

## Changeset level: taken from the gate, not from prose

`minor` on `@object-ui/types`, with the breaking semantics spelled out in the
body. `check-changeset-no-major` is what forbids `major` here (this repository's
fixed group rides `@objectstack`'s major), and `minor` is its verdict. The
disposition line is `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, written into the changeset
body. ⚠️ Measured while writing it: this repository has **no**
`check:adr-0087-registration` gate — zero matches in `scripts/` and
`.github/`, against a control of three changeset gates that do resolve — so the
line is carried per the ruling and the sibling repository's spelling, ⛔ not
because a local gate parses it.

## ⚠️ The limit this change does NOT close

The card recorded that its zero covered `packages/**` and `apps/**` only and
that it did **not** enumerate customer applications or published documents. That
limit stands, and the ruling was taken with it attached.

⇒ Everything above is the **IN-REPO HALF**. `git grep` reads this repository's
tracked files: ⛔ not customer applications, ⛔ not published documents, ⛔ not
tenant metadata at rest, ⛔ not untracked files. It is ⛔ **not** proof that
nothing in the world authors `type: 'ai-insights'`. `@object-ui/types` is
published, so an external consumer that authored the node is structurally
unobservable from here — it gets the TS2305 above, which is why the FROM/TO is
in the changeset. Such a consumer's document was already being refused at run
time by both the OBJUI-001 panel and the CLI validator.

## Acceptance notes

- **Noted, ⛔ not filed.** The published zod union `AnyComponentSchema` refuses
  all four AI spellings, including the three that ARE registered and rendered
  (`ai-recommendations`, `ai-form-assist`, `nl-query` — measured above, with a
  `button` control that passes). That is the *opposite* direction from this card
  — registered but undeclared — and it already has a carrier: objectui#8499
  measured 505 registered keys with no arm, on that exact gap. Successor reader
  exists, so no new card. ⛔ Out of scope here and untouched.
- **Noted, ⛔ not filed.** `check-readme-exports` and `check-dist-completeness`
  both failed loudly and correctly on unbuilt/partial state during this work,
  each naming its own repair in its output. Working as designed; recorded so the
  two red lines in this branch's logs are not read as findings.
